# Credit Monitoring Plugin

> AI-assisted private-credit monitoring for Claude Cowork. Analysts remain responsible for review and credit decisions.

## Canonical documents

- README.md: product overview, support, installation, workflow, and responsibility boundary
- docs/GETTING_STARTED.md: installation, folders, first run, and dashboard creation
- docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md: runtime architecture, storage, and responsibilities
- docs/SECURITY_AND_PRIVACY.md: local-file and Claude-processing boundaries
- docs/LIMITATIONS.md: unsupported capabilities and professional-use limitations
- SECURITY.md: private vulnerability reporting
- CONTRIBUTING.md: contribution expectations

## Output taxonomy

A borrower run produces two person-facing deliverables: a financial workbook and a monitoring memo. The optional portfolio dashboard is a derived aggregate view of selected completed runs, not a third borrower-run deliverable.

## Support

Claude Cowork is supported in v1. Other agent harnesses are not supported or promised. Same-link hosted dashboard updates and migration of pre-v1 monitoring runs are unsupported.
